name: Seisenki Valkyrie Sisters ~Yami ni Ochita Idol~
original_name: 聖戦姫ヴァルキュア・シスターズ～淫闇に堕ちたアイドル～
source:
The popular idol duo, W's profile was shrouded in mystery, but their true identity was none other than the Valkyria Sisters, princesses of the Kingdom of Light who fled to the human world due to the invasion of the dark world!
The protagonist, a young and inexperienced photographer named Masaki, accidentally discovers the sisters' secret. Together, the three of them team up to battle the evil organization called Gartlrada but...
translation:
人气偶像组合W的资料一直笼罩在神秘之中；而她们的真实身份，正是因黑暗世界入侵而逃到人类世界的光之王国公主——瓦尔基里姐妹！
年轻且缺乏经验的摄影师陆奥正树意外发现了姐妹的秘密。三人联手对抗名为“加特尔拉达”的邪恶组织，然而……
